Package com.nexuslink.protocol.grpc

Class ProtoFileLoader

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.grpc.ProtoFileLoader
public final class ProtoFileLoader extends Object
A dependency-free parser for a .proto file — the offline alternative to server reflection (§6.1). It extracts what the method picker needs: the syntax + package, the declared message type names, and each service's RPCs with their input/output types and client/server streaming flags. It is a structural parser (not a full protobuf compiler): comments are stripped, then services are brace-matched and their rpc lines scanned. Pure and JavaFX-free, so it is fully unit-testable.
